goal: Enforce the change record check in agent-kit now, as Beau decided on H16 after two days of observe mode.
changed: validate.yml runs debrief.py check --base without --observe, so a pull request that changes a file outside the bookkeeping files and adds no change record, or adds a bad one, fails validate, which main requires.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's gate audit row says the check is enforced and that a pull request can still edit the check itself (H13).
H16 records the answer. quality, finances and agent-ledger stay in observe until the exempt list is widened.

claims.claim: The enforced check fails exactly the agent-kit pull requests observe mode flagged for a missing record (#76, #78, #81, #85) and passes the other ten it ran on.
claims.check: debrief.py check --base <base> with no --observe, on a detached checkout of each PR head #74 to #88 except the closed #83; macOS, Python 3
claims.remaining: #88 passes locally but failed in CI: its record cites 58bc6e8, a commit that exists only on this Mac. CI's checkout lacks it, so CI is the stricter of the two.

claims.claim: This pull request passes the enforced check in CI.
claims.remaining: The validate run on this pull request is the proof; read its step log before merging.

next.item: Widen the exempt list for briefs, books, ledger rows, questions.md and docs/notes, then enforce in quality, finances and agent-ledger
next.why_now: The scheduled brief PRs in quality and finances touch only those paths, and quality requires change-record on main.
next.impact: Enforced without it, every weekly brief PR in quality stops merging until someone writes a record by hand.

next.item: Make 58bc6e8 reachable or point the no-comments record's fourth claim at a commit on main
next.why_now: Any pull request that edits that record now fails validate.
next.impact: Until then the claim's evidence names a commit nobody but this Mac can read.

next.item: Stop a pull request from editing its own check
next.why_now: Enforcement makes the check worth getting around.
next.impact: Today an agent can drop the step or widen the exempt list in the same pull request; only review would notice.
